title: GLOBAL PARTNERS LP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Global Partners LP, a master limited partnership engaged in energy product sales and operations, filed a Form 8-K on April 13, 2026 announcing a quarterly cash distribution of $0.59375 per unit ($2.375 per unit annualized) on its 9.50% Series B Fixed Rate Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Units, payable on May 15, 2026 to unitholders of record as of May 1, 2026. This is a routine corporate disclosure unrelated to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Global Partners LP declared a quarterly cash distribution of $0.59375 per unit on Series B preferred units
The distribution rate is $2.375 per unit on an annualized basis at 9.50% fixed rate
Payment date is May 15, 2026; record date is May 1, 2026
The filing is submitted under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure)
The common units (GLP) and preferred units (GLP pr B) trade on NYSE
Company is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts
